## Post-deploy smoke test

Press **Execute Workflow**, open the `Checks` node, read the table.

Runs entirely inside n8n — no terminal, no curl, no PowerShell, no python. Works on an iPad and on any browser.

**Before the first run:** set `SVC` on the `Checks` node to the growth-enrich Railway URL (no trailing slash).

Every check names what it PROVES and what a failure MEANS. A FAIL here is a real defect: do not run a ticker until it is green.

First call after a deploy may take ~60s (Railway cold start) — that is not a failure.
